provider: HKUST 2025/26 Science Group A with Extended Major in Artificial Intelligence
note: The official admissions page states that students select Chemistry, Mathematics, Ocean Science and Technology, or Physics after Year 1 and complete that discipline together with the Extended Major in Artificial Intelligence. This supplement replaces the aggregate placeholder with four isolated Programme-local Major choices. Each choice reuses its intake-specific base Major course universe and the 75-row EXTM-AI component; duplicate codes within a choice remain one course record. The lists remain read-only because each base Major contains Track, Option, open-pool or approval-dependent rules and the Extended Major adds alternative capstones, elective minima, single-counting and no-reuse constraints that the local rule engine cannot close automatically. totalCreditRequired remains 0 and no graduation-completion percentage may be produced.
